confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge, not live listings. Restaurant and coffee anchors are the most reliable. Hotel prices are the least certain: they vary widely with event calendars and conventions, and the 3-star anchor may exclude resort fees. Las Vegas has few registered hostels, so the hostel anchors are lower confidence. Beer and cocktail prices are Strip-weighted, and cocktail and wine were estimated from the beer price where direct knowledge was weak.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single close comparable. Based on US resort and tourist-city pricing (e.g., Orlando and Phoenix-type markets), adjusted upward for the Las Vegas Strip casino and resort premium on drinks and rooms. July is peak heat and a lower-demand season for leisure visitors, so room anchors are set below peak-season levels.
